channel.description: Latest articles from Marin Independent Journal (marinij.com)

item.title: Want to see great art? Spend a day in West Marin
item.description: Four concurrent exhibits offer an amazing range of style and substance — and all within one block of each other.

item.title: Sports briefs: COM on verge of ending postseason drought
item.description: The College of Marin men's basketball team is expected to make the 3C2A playoffs for the first time in more than a decade when the brackets are unveiled during Saturday's seeding meeting.

item.title: Warriors share results of Steph Curry’s MRI on ailing right knee
item.description: Steph Curry will miss his sixth consecutive game with runner's knee

item.title: Exclusive: How one backcountry guiding company owner narrowly missed being part of group hit by deadly Tahoe avalanche
item.description: "It's a really tight community, and it's really devastating," Sarah Reynaud said. "It's just a horrific situation."

item.title: Alysa Liu adds her name to Bay Area’s Olympic skating icons
item.description: She's the fourth Bay Area skater to win individual gold at the Winter Olympics, and the seventh medalist from the region overall

item.title: Marin looks to ease food business regulations
item.description: “Our new focus is about moving from a perceived gatekeeper role to a partnership model," said Sarah Jones, director of the Marin County Community Development Agency.

item.title: Marin residents among victims of Sierra avalanche
item.description: A statement from a group of families identifies six of the eight fatalities, while a ninth victim remains unaccounted for.

item.title: Ex-Pittsburg High QB Jaden Rashada settles breach of contract suit over failed $14M NIL deal
item.description: Rashada, a redshirt junior with Mississippi State, his fourth college since leaving Pittsburg High, was seeking at least $10 million in his complaint against former Florida coach Billy Napier, among others.

item.title: Warriors routed by Celtics in Kristaps Porzingis’ debut with Golden State
item.description: The Warriors were outscored 17-2 during Porzingis' first stretch of playing time since the Warriors acquired him from Atlanta.

item.title: Boys basketball: Marin Catholic’s rally falls just short in Open battle
item.description: There was plenty of doubt Thursday as Marin Catholic made its first foray into the open division of the North Coast Section boys basketball playoffs.
